headline: ServiceNow Plunges Nearly 18% Premarket Following Third-Quarter Earnings
summary: Shares in software company ServiceNow dropped nearly 18% in premarket trading on Thursday as investors evaluated its third-quarter financial results.
why: ServiceNow is a leading enterprise cloud software vendor whose quarterly performance is viewed as an indicator of broader corporate IT spending.

impacts.name: ServiceNow Inc
